name: Cityscapes Benchmark
description: Autonomous driving benchmark with urban street scenes, focused on pixel-level semantic understanding, instance segmentation, and related driving-relevant perception tasks.
evaluation_method: mIoU for semantic segmentation, AP for instance segmentation and detection, disparity error for stereo tasks, and task-specific leaderboard metrics
typical_sota_score: semantic segmentation mIoU typically around 80%+ on validation-style evaluations
notes: A key benchmark for urban driving perception. Strongly associated with real-world autonomous driving research and robust scene understanding.
